verbatim_source_excerpt: **AMZN — AWS 고성장과 잉여현금흐름 악화의 충돌, 매수 대기(watch_only).**
thesis: Oct 29 post-close Q3 revenue $201.9bn (+12% YoY), AWS +39.3%, operating income $28.1bn, but TTM FCF -$42.4bn versus +$14.8bn one year prior; 2026 cash capex guide ~$220bn.

invalidation: FCF deteriorates further without incremental AWS returns, revenue/guidance weakens, or price relative to SPY stays negative.
entry_trigger: Watch only if price reclaims Oct 29 close $243.79 and confirms positive relative strength, adequate liquidity and sustainable close; Oct 30 range $229.36-$241.55.
trigger_validity: Next 1-5 NYSE sessions; 2-6 weeks/multi-month requires cashflow conversion and valuation review.
target_and_stop_basis: Oct 30 low $229.36 is a gap-risk reference, not a stop order; no first-profit target or R:R until ATR/structure/fees validated.
